description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
